Run R and Python locally with a shared workspace, console and plots. Bundled examples run offline; extra packages and imported code may use the network.

This page describes the October 2026 source revision. These source changes are not part of older development release downloads. Local checks are distinct from device, live-service and store acceptance.

[Current implementation, prerequisites and commands](../current-status.qmd)
